import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    
    # Fix island label variants
    island_mapping = {
        'Torgerson': 'Torgersen',
        'Bisco': 'Biscoe'
    }
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace(island_mapping)
    
    # Fix sex label variants (convert to lowercase)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to number (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Filter to only Adelie penguins
    df = df[df['species'] == 'Adelie']
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by island and compute average bill length
    result = df.groupby('island')['bill_length_mm'].mean().round(2).to_dict()
    return result
